_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate (only 12% of 12h windows move ±2) plus unbroken spot and flat funding make HOLD the skilled call; downside skew/netflow/gold are building but not the breaker yet.
next_move.brains_agree: No — Analyst explicit HOLD/CAUTION on BTC ladder; Narrative is oil-supply headline with no crypto phase/direction call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC 30d change stays inside ~±3%, fear/greed holds 50-62, funding stays near flat
next_move.invalidated_if: momentum_30d under 45 with fear/greed losing 50 and funding flipping to 0 or negative while skew and exchange netflow stay pinned at extremes
